properties.name: jwt.secret.key
properties.description: The secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. It should be kept private and secure.

properties.name: jwt.expiration.time
properties.description: The duration after which a generated JWT token expires. Typically defined in milliseconds or a time format.

properties.name: spring.application.default-username
properties.description: The default username assigned to the initial application user when no users are present in the system.

properties.name: spring.application.default-email
properties.description: The default email address associated with the initial application user account.

properties.name: spring.application.default-password
properties.description: The default password for the initial application user. This should be changed after first login for security reasons.

properties.name: origin.url
properties.description: The allowed origin URL for cross-origin requests (CORS). Defines which client domains can access the application.
